content_of_post_to_answer: Isn’t it great that we get another day to try to get things right?
answer: A new day is valuable not because it erases yesterday, but because it gives us another chance to respond differently to what yesterday taught us. Many people see mistakes as evidence of failure; a wiser view is to treat them as information. The real privilege of another day is not unlimited time, but another opportunity to make a better choice with what we already know.
